maddeler.e:
نشرئب (form IVq)
# نَشْرَئِبُّ (našraʔibbu) /naʃ.ra.ʔib.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِشْرَأَبَّ (išraʔabba)
# نَشْرَئِبَّ (našraʔibba) /naʃ.ra.ʔib.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْرَأَبَّ (išraʔabba)
# نَشْرَئِبِّ (našraʔibbi) /naʃ.ra.ʔib.bi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِشْرَأَبَّ (išraʔabba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
